## Rationale

The existing `CloseRefused` path already blocks unmet `done` closes (exit 2) and already has a finding escape. Putting red-first there makes the engine refuse pass-only `tdd` closes the same way it refuses unmet criteria, matching issue #6 and the check-runner trust boundary. The user chose approach A over lint-heavy or skill-only options.

## Counter-argument

Close-plus-lint (approach B) would also surface the ~150 historical pass-only `done` items via `validate --strict` or a dashboard badge, so the dogfood store debt stays visible. Deferring that keeps old closes silent until a later phase.
